claims.statement: Advanced gastric cancer with peritoneal-spread risk can warrant laparoscopic staging despite unrevealing cross-sectional imaging.
claims.limitation: Current Japanese CQ4-2 is a weak recommendation; direct current independent staging-guideline corroboration was not established. No universal cT1/cT2 rule is asserted.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the stated gastric neoplasm and represented care phase

claims.statement: Positive peritoneal cytology found before initial gastric-cancer treatment supports systemic treatment before reconsidering resection after clearance.
claims.limitation: Single directly verified current guideline for this exact chronology. CY1 discovered during gastrectomy has a different weak Japanese recommendation; no universal permanent prohibition on surgery.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the stated gastric neoplasm and represented care phase

claims.statement: Lymphatic invasion after gastric endoscopic resection prevents routine endoscopic-curability status despite clear margins.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the stated gastric neoplasm and represented care phase

claims.statement: A surgically fit patient with lymphovascular invasion after gastric endoscopic resection should be considered for gastrectomy with lymphadenectomy.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the stated gastric neoplasm and represented care phase

claims.statement: Capecitabine with oxaliplatin is an evidence-supported postoperative regimen for stage II/III gastric cancer after curative D2 resection.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the stated gastric neoplasm and represented care phase

claims.statement: Routine chemoradiation has no established survival advantage over platinum-combination adjuvant chemotherapy after curative D2 gastric resection.
claims.limitation: Local-control effects are not denied. Do not generalize this comparison to R1 margins or an inadequate lymphadenectomy.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the stated gastric neoplasm and represented care phase

claims.statement: Postoperative nivolumab added to chemotherapy after upfront D2 gastric surgery is not an established replacement for evidence-supported adjuvant chemotherapy.
claims.limitation: JGCA discusses negative ATTRACTION-5. This does not settle all current perioperative immunotherapy choices.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the stated gastric neoplasm and represented care phase

claims.statement: Proximal gastric cancer without greater-curvature, splenic or hilar involvement does not justify routine prophylactic splenectomy.
claims.limitation: The independently verified older exact approval remains historical; disputed English JGCA CQ3-2 wording is withheld.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the stated gastric neoplasm and represented care phase

claims.statement: An organ directly invaded by gastric cancer may require combined resection to obtain clear margins.
claims.limitation: Does not support a universal post-treatment adhesion/peeling rule or automatic multivisceral resectability.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the stated gastric neoplasm and represented care phase

claims.statement: A gastric-cancer operation does not require prophylactic pancreatic resection merely because splenic resection is indicated.
claims.limitation: Single directly verified guideline scope plus constructed separately documented organ planes; not an exact ranking for an inseparable treated interface.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the stated gastric neoplasm and represented care phase

claims.statement: For a gastric mass being considered for preoperative GIST drug treatment, representative core tissue supports histology and molecular workup.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the stated gastric neoplasm and represented care phase

claims.statement: EUS-guided sampling is a preferred route for a reachable localized gastric-wall mass needing pretreatment tissue.
claims.limitation: FNA with adequate cell-block material and percutaneous sampling can be appropriate; they are not universally inadequate or unsafe.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the stated gastric neoplasm and represented care phase

claims.statement: Histologic and molecular conclusions apply to the represented sampled tissue, so a superficial mucosal sample does not classify an unsampled deeper mass.
claims.limitation: Anatomic specimen logic applied to constructed records; not a numerical biopsy-sensitivity claim.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the stated gastric neoplasm and represented care phase

claims.statement: Previously obtained representative GIST tissue can support subsequent molecular testing when its identity and analytic adequacy are established.
claims.limitation: Tissue banking and molecular principles support the application; the exact banked-core-versus-repeat-biopsy ranking is constructed specimen logic, not a trial-tested comparison.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the stated gastric neoplasm and represented care phase

claims.statement: KIT exon 11 GIST is generally imatinib responsive, whereas PDGFRA D842V predicts imatinib resistance.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the stated gastric neoplasm and represented care phase

claims.statement: Preoperative imatinib can reduce surgical morbidity in a genotype-responsive GIST whose initial resection would be extensive.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the stated gastric neoplasm and represented care phase

claims.statement: On matched contrast CT, falling GIST attenuation can indicate treatment response even without a reduction in diameter.
claims.limitation: No Choi cutoff or response percentage is invented; suspicious new nodules or worsening disease require reassessment.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the stated gastric neoplasm and represented care phase

claims.statement: Suspected true GIST progression warrants review of adherence and interactions before dose escalation or switching systemic treatment.
claims.limitation: No exact rescue dose, schedule or universal escalation ranking is authored.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the stated gastric neoplasm and represented care phase

claims.statement: Localized gastric GIST surgery aims at complete excision with an intact capsule; limited gastric resection is often adequate.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the stated gastric neoplasm and represented care phase

claims.statement: Routine regional lymphadenectomy is usually unnecessary for conventional GIST without suspicious nodes; SDH-deficient disease is a boundary.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the stated gastric neoplasm and represented care phase

claims.statement: A microscopic GIST margin alone does not establish rupture, require morbid completion resection or independently indicate adjuvant imatinib.
claims.limitation: Re-excision remains individualized if low morbidity; the draft compares surveillance against a documented major completion operation.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the stated gastric neoplasm and represented care phase

claims.statement: Avapritinib treats adult unresectable or metastatic GIST with PDGFRA exon 18 alterations including D842V.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the stated gastric neoplasm and represented care phase

claims.statement: Complete resection of PDGFRA D842V GIST does not justify adjuvant imatinib; avapritinib has no established routine adjuvant indication.
claims.limitation: Clinical trials are not excluded. No claim about a universal surveillance interval or optimal adjuvant duration.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the stated gastric neoplasm and represented care phase

claims.statement: Radiographic disappearance or resection of metastatic imatinib-responsive GIST does not justify routine interruption of effective imatinib.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the stated gastric neoplasm and represented care phase

claims.statement: Gastric MALT classification integrates morphology and phenotype; CD20 or clonality alone does not establish its subtype.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the stated gastric neoplasm and represented care phase

claims.statement: After eradication, asymptomatic regressing residual MALT can be monitored; symptomatic or overtly progressive localized disease can warrant involved-site radiotherapy.
claims.limitation: Used to audit retained passed items; no new universal waiting interval or radiation dose authored.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the stated gastric neoplasm and represented care phase

claims.statement: Clearly delineated sheets of large B cells support a large-cell lymphoma component; scattered large cells are insufficient.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the stated gastric neoplasm and represented care phase

claims.statement: An uncertain gastric lymphoma classification warrants additional diagnostic tissue rather than treating the prior subtype as established.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the stated gastric neoplasm and represented care phase

claims.statement: FDG PET/CT contributes to initial staging of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma beyond gastric-wall depth assessment.
claims.limitation: Only one independently verified government summary supplies this exact new staging application; no copied Lugano tables or proprietary criteria.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the stated gastric neoplasm and represented care phase

claims.statement: Fit patients with early-stage gastric large B-cell lymphoma can receive R-CHOP-based systemic therapy rather than routine gastrectomy.
claims.limitation: Exact regimen, radiation addition and cycle count require hematology review; drafted H. pylori-negative transformed disease is outside selected antibiotic-responsive series.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the stated gastric neoplasm and represented care phase

claims.statement: FDA approval in November 2025 added perioperative durvalumab with FLOT for resectable adult gastric or gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma.
claims.limitation: Research currency warning only; no drafted answer ranks FLOT alone against this regimen.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the stated gastric neoplasm and represented care phase

claims.statement: Localized low-grade H. pylori-associated gastric MALT is initially treated with eradication and subsequent lymphoma-response assessment.
claims.limitation: This does not make eradication the only treatment for aggressive or threatening disease.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the represented gastric tumor and treatment phase

claims.statement: A negative BIRC3-MALT1 result does not exclude gastric MALT when integrated histologic findings support it.
claims.limitation: No exact molecular sensitivity or universal exclusion rule is asserted.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the represented gastric tumor and treatment phase

claims.statement: Compatible gastric mesenchymal morphology with DOG1 and CD117 expression supports GIST classification in an integrated pathologic assessment.
claims.limitation: A single stain does not establish every GIST, and negative staining does not universally exclude it.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the represented gastric tumor and treatment phase

claims.statement: GIST recurrence assessment uses site, size, mitotic activity and rupture; mitotic counts are reported per 5 mm2.
claims.limitation: Constructed case values are observations, not new exact cutoffs or quoted risk percentages.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the represented gastric tumor and treatment phase

claims.statement: Sunitinib is a standard next-line option after imatinib failure or intolerance in an appropriate GIST setting.
claims.limitation: No exact dose or claim that this treats primary PDGFRA D842V resistance is authored.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the represented gastric tumor and treatment phase

claims.statement: Potentially curable gastric cancer reaching muscularis propria or deeper generally warrants D2 lymphadenectomy in the represented operative setting.
claims.limitation: Current exact JGCA scope is verified; independent current guideline verification of this specific layer-to-extent comparison was not completed.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the represented gastric tumor and treatment phase

claims.statement: A new clinically discordant lesion or elevated LDH during marginal-zone lymphoma follow-up can raise concern for high-grade transformation, which requires histologic confirmation rather than diagnosis from PET uptake alone.
claims.limitation: Targeted BSH guidance supports suspicion and tissue confirmation. No SUV, growth-rate or LDH cutoff diagnoses transformation; only one directly verified specialty guideline supports this exact teaching point.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the represented gastric-region lymphoma and clinical treatment phase

claims.statement: When transformation is suspected in marginal-zone lymphoma, PET/CT can help select a representative lesion for biopsy; tissue from a different low-grade site does not settle the changing lesion’s histology.
claims.limitation: Site-specific application is independent clinical synthesis of representative-tissue and PET-directed biopsy guidance. No universal needle-versus-excision hierarchy or diagnostic SUV threshold is asserted; single direct guideline limitation retained.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the represented gastric-region lymphoma and clinical treatment phase

claims.statement: Persistent substantial systolic dysfunction can make doxorubicin inappropriate for initial large-B-cell lymphoma treatment even when general performance and other organ function are preserved.
claims.limitation: EHA explicitly addresses LVEF below 50% or heart-failure signs. The constructed LVEF of 30% is a patient observation, not a newly invented cutoff. Individual cardio-oncology assessment remains necessary.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the represented gastric-region lymphoma and clinical treatment phase

claims.statement: R-CEOP replaces doxorubicin with etoposide and is an accepted offered initial regimen for anthracycline-ineligible large-B-cell lymphoma.
claims.limitation: Other accepted specialist alternatives exist. Observational outcomes are not proof of equivalence to R-CHOP, and no ranking among equally eligible anthracycline-free regimens is taught.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the represented gastric-region lymphoma and clinical treatment phase

claims.statement: R-mini-CHOP retains doxorubicin; a dose-attenuated CHOP strategy does not remove anthracycline exposure when cardiac ineligibility is the relevant constraint.
claims.limitation: Guideline describes attenuated treatment in a separate older/fitness context and recommends non-anthracycline regimens for cardiac dysfunction. No dose, cycle count or age-only prescribing rule is authored; one direct guideline supports this exact contrast.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adults with the represented gastric-region lymphoma and clinical treatment phase
